query:
UPDATE app_user_profile 
        SET 
            owner_email = $1,
            full_name = COALESCE($2, full_name),
            preferred_name = COALESCE($3, preferred_name),
            server_status = 'ready',
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
